title: Replying to @zoethomaswebb A lot is an understatement #downstate #new...
transcript: it was a lot is an incredibly accurate statement in regards to Downstate downstate is a new play that has a premise that I probably can't even describe on this app without being immediately expunged from it this show has so many trigger warnings I in fact had somebody spoil the entire thing for me before even going going in and I'm really glad that I did that I have come to learn about myself that when a show is about a very traumatic subject matter that I should just know what I'm getting into ahead of time it helps me appreciate the work even more this play is brilliantly written the cast is absolutely insanely perfect it's definitely a show I'll be thinking about for decades I love works of art that are able to bring humanity especially to people who think differently than I do it is one of the reasons why I love Heroes of the 4th Turning as a play and Downstate is a play that brings humanity to characters we can all agree and morally reprehensible in my opinion is able to walk that line absolutely perfectly this is a play that can be very triggering but it is brilliant and if you get a chance go see it
